name: Bootstrapping (confidence interval by resampling)
when_to_use: Estimate the sampling distribution/confidence interval of a statistic (e.g., quantile, mean) without assuming normality; any numeric variable.

expected_input.question: What is the confidence interval of a statistic without assuming normality?

plain_explanation.purpose: Estimates the uncertainty of a result by drawing data from the dataset itself many times.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want a confidence interval without relying on formulas that assume the shape of the data.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Any table; works even with few rows.
plain_explanation.example: Give an interval for the conversion rate of a small sample of opportunities.
plain_explanation.diagram: dataset -> resample with replacement 1000x -> compute 1000x -> range holding 95%
